items.proposed: Do not count as selection: the 'Histone altered glioma' exclusion is CNS5-defining, exempt from any_molecular_selection (H3K27M category also not supported)
items.reason: D31-A5 exempts exclusions that only define CNS5 glioblastoma ('IDH mutant glioma', 'Histone altered glioma' with 'biopsy proven IDH- wild type GBM') from any_molecular_selection.

The tested intervention is a radiotherapy schedule ('The test arms will comprise of dose escalated hypo-fractionated RT'; 'The usage of TMZ will be standard across both arms'), so D31-C1 assigns excluded_intervention_type.

note: Moot for analysis: the trial fails S3 (phase NA) and S6; the S6 reason is now excluded_intervention_type (D31-C1, RT-fractionation trial; temozolomide soc_backbone in both arms). The histone-alteration exclusion is CNS5-defining and exempt under D31-A5. Nothing pending for XL.
